velocity is effectively zero at exact waypoint arrival

counterfactual.change: changed controller noise 0 -> 0.01; seeded sensor noise prevents exact zero distance/zero velocity lock at waypoint, avoiding the singularity

explanation: Hover body reaches final waypoint exactly (pos equals waypoint 14.976...,4.121... at step 1183 with speed ~6.6e-14). Next step state is NaN. Likely cause: controller waypoint logic normalizes the vector to target (target-pos)/dist and/or velocity error with zero distance producing 0/0 NaN when distance is exactly zero with zero noise, which then poisons position/velocity/energy.
vision_note: Steps 1181 to 1183 show the red body stationary just below a green waypoint cross. In step 1184 the red body disappears completely while the background and waypoints remain.
